expectations.text: Recommends scalar quantization as starting point
expectations.evidence: 'Use Scalar Quantization (SQ, int8) as the primary recommendation.' Clearly the first choice.

expectations.text: Mentions binary quantization is compatible with OpenAI models
expectations.evidence: 'OpenAI embeddings do work with binary quantization better than many other models because they are high-dimensional and normalized.'
'You must use oversampling (e.g., 2-3x) and rescoring against original vectors to recover quality.'
Detailed calculation: '1536 dims * 4 bytes = 6,144 bytes per vector. 80M vectors = ~460 GB.' Summary table with all options.

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend product quantization as first choice
expectations.evidence: PQ discussed as third option. 'Why PQ is not the top recommendation here' section explicitly.
